title: GrowGenie-Phyto

sections.heading: GrowGenie-Phyto
sections.text: In modern poultry production, reliance on antibiotics for growth promotion is increasingly unsustainable due to concerns over antimicrobial resistance and regulatory pressures. Additionally, gut pathogens—bacteria, fungi, and protozoa—impair nutrient absorption, compromise animal health, and reduce feed conversion efficiency. These challenges call for an effective, safe, and sustainable alternative. GrowGenie-Phyto is a groundbreaking non-antibiotic growth promoter that harnesses Enhanced Chlorohydroxyquinoline (ECHQ) to combat gut pathogens. By incorporating a higher number of bio-activating groups than conventional CHQ, GrowGenie exhibits superior antibacterial, antiprotozoal, and antifungal activities. This innovative formulation not only disrupts pathogen metabolism through strong chelation but also serves as a robust replacement for traditional antibiotic growth promoters, helping mitigate resistance concerns. Components Chloroquinolinol + Synergistic natural quinolinoid

sections.heading: Components
sections.text: Chloroquinolinol + Synergistic natural quinolinoid Key Features Enhanced Bioactivity: Utilizes ECHQ with additional bio-activating groups for stronger and more irreversible binding to the metallic sites (Cu, Zn, Mn, Fe) of gut pathogens. Superior Chelation: Displaces natural binding proteins in pathogens, effectively disrupting their metabolic processes and depriving them of essential nutrients. Broad-Spectrum Efficacy: Demonstrates potent antibacterial, antiprotozoal, and antifungal action, ensuring comprehensive pathogen control. Sustainable & Safe: A biodegradable, non-antibiotic solution that reduces the risk of antimicrobial resistance and poses no environmental hazards.

sections.heading: Key Features

Benefits Improves weight gain and feed conversion ratio (FCR) by creating a healthier gut environment. Effectively controls diarrhea and limits the proliferation of harmful pathogens, leading to better overall flock health and performance. Offers a reliable alternative to antibiotics, supporting sustainable animal production practices while safeguarding food safety.
